2026-11-02.homeNewsDetails: Swayman will start vs. Vegas on Monday.
2026-11-02.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Bruins lead the Atlantic Division with a 10-4-1 record, largely thanks to Jeremy Swayman's stellar play. That said, Swayman is coming off his worst performance of this season, allowing four goals on 18 shots (.778 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the St. Louis Blues. The 27-year-old American goalie has a 2.35 GAA and .912 SV% in 11 games this season (7-3-1). The Bruins enter Monday's outing as slight +104 home underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team that has scored two or fewer goals in four of their last five games (1-3-1).
2026-11-02.awayNewsDetails: Hart led the Golden Knights onto the ice for warmups.

2026-11-02.homeNewsDetails: Markstrom (upper-body) will return and start vs. Detroit on Monday.
2026-11-02.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Markstrom has missed over two weeks due to an upper-body injury but will return to the crease on Monday against the Detroit Red Wings. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie has been serviceable early in his Panthers tenure, posting a 3-1-1 record, but has been lightly tested most nights, resulting in a pedestrian .897 SV% and a 2.21 GAA. The Panthers enter Monday's contest as -171 home favourites against a Red Wings team that has scored four or more goals in five of their last seven games (4-2-1).
2026-11-02.awayNewsDetails: Tarasov will start in Florida on Monday.
2026-11-02.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Last season, Tarasov posted a 3.05 GAA and .895 SV% in 33 games (13-15-3) with the Florida Panthers, and he will face his former team for the first time since joining the Red Wings. The 27-year-old Russian goalie has been used sparingly this season, but has been solid when called upon, posting a 1.40 GAA and .940 SV% in four appearances (1-0-2). The Red Wings enter Monday's outing as +155 road underdogs against a Panthers team on a three-game winning streak.

2026-11-02.homeNewsDetails: Knight will start vs. Colorado on Monday.
2026-11-02.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After a promising inaugural full season with the Blackhawks in 2025-26, posting a 2.82 GAA and .902 SV% in 55 games (19-25-11), Knight has had an inconsistent start to 2026-27. That said, he has strung together a few good outings, posting a 2.37 GAA and .922 SV% in his last three games (1-2-0). The 25-year-old American goalie has a 3.21 GAA and .897 SV% in 11 games this season (4-7-0). The Blackhawks enter Monday's game as sizeable +192 home underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team that has scored five or more goals in three of their last four games (3-1-0).
2026-11-02.awayNewsDetails: Blackwood will start in Chicago on Monday.
2026-11-02.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Colorado Head Coach Jared Bednar has favoured Mackenzie Blackwood early in the 2026-27 season and will continue rolling with him on Monday against the Chicago Blackhawks. The 29-year-old Blackwood saved 25 of 27 shots (.926 SV%) in his most recent game, a 5-2 win over the Calgary Flames. Blackwood has allowed three or fewer goals in six straight games (5-1-0), posting a 2.35 GAA and .915 SV%. The Avalanche enter the action as significant -222 road favourites.

2026-11-02.homeNewsDetails: Askarov will start vs. Calgary on Monday.
2026-11-02.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Sharks have lost three of their last four (1-3-0), but have received solid goaltending from Askarov in recent games. Askarov started the season with a dreadful 4.00 GAA and .848 SV% in his first five games (2-3-0), but has an impressive 1.76 GAA and .950 SV% in his last four (2-2-0). The Sharks enter Monday's action as -120 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team that has scored two or fewer goals in two of their last three games (1-2-0).
2026-11-02.awayNewsDetails: Wolf will start in San Jose on Monday.
2026-11-02.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Dustin Wolf's unencouraging play to start the 2026-27 season led the team to rely on Devin Cooley, who started five straight games toward the end of October. That said, Cooley's injury gave Wolf a chance to make his mark between the pipes, and he did in his most recent outing, saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 6-2 win over the Seattle Kraken. The 25-year-old Wolf has an ugly 4.39 GAA and .847 SV% in seven appearances (2-4-0) this season. The Flames enter Monday's game as slight +109 road underdogs against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored only four goals combined in its past three games (1-2-0).

2026-11-03.homeNewsDetails: Bobrovsky will start vs. Utah on Tuesday.
2026-11-03.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Bobrovsky's start in Toronto has been unencouraging, as he's been regularly outplayed by counterpart Anthony Stolarz, but he returns to the crease Tuesday. The 38-year-old Bobrovsky has allowed three or more goals in nine of 10 games this season and is coming off his worst performance so far, allowing five goals on 17 shots (.706 SV%) in a 5-4 loss to the Seattle Kraken. He has a 3.29 GAA, .885 SV%, and a 3-5-2 record.
